d: Short, spiky platinum white hair with blunt bangs and a youthful, mature facial appearance. Bright blue, wide eyes with a cheerful expression. A slender build, wearing a black bikini top and matching bottoms under a long, flowing grey and white coat with a white fur collar and neon pink accents, paired with black ankle boots and a black thigh-high sock on one leg. Accessories include a black headset with cat ears and pink circular accents, a black utility belt with pouches, and two black submachine guns.
